title: The first 100.
body_1: Founder 100 is the first production allocation in KAIZURO history. Each Founder becomes part of the transition from prototype to production and part of the group that proves KAIZURO can exist on its own terms.
body_2: This is not a discounted preorder designed to generate volume. It is a limited ownership release built around traceability, participation and long-term connection to the brand.
deposit_body: Choose your Founder rod, pay the correct 25% deposit through Square, then submit your ownership details below. Your deposit is credited in full against the final Founder purchase price.
closing_line: Only 100 people will ever own a KAIZURO Founder Edition rod. Once allocated, this offer will never be repeated.
